title: Avoidance Radius Debug Drawing for Navigation Agent 2D instances aren't rendering
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in Godot 4.7.stable.official [5b4e0cb0f]

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot Engine v4.7.stable.official.5b4e0cb0f - OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 591.86 - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti

### Issue description

In my project I have the following project wide debug options enabled:
- visible navigation
- visible avoidance

My navigation agent individually has its debug flag set and avoidance enabled. Functionally, path-finding with avoidance is working just fine and matching the avoidance radii  & neighbor distance I am setting, but I can't seem to get the actual radius to draw.

I've also tried choosing a hot pink custom color in Project Settings -> Debug -> Shapes -> Avoidance -> 2D -> Agents Radius Color. I've also tried hiding any in-game visual elements that could be obstructing it, and also setting the ordering of the navigation agent itself to be the highest in the scene tree.

Navigation Obstacle 2D debug radii are rendering just fine, only navigation agent 2Ds seem to be the issue.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Make sure all project-side debug flags are enabled (visible navigation + visible avoidance)
2. Make sure there is an active navigation agent with avoidance & debug enabled (the included sample project should already do this)
3. Run the game in editor. Paths are drawing, and if you added nav obstacles those will draw too, but agent radii are nowhere to be seen.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[nav_agent_2d_radii_debug_bug_repro.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33223109/nav_agent_2d_radii_debug_bug_repro.zip)
